== Card credits ==
The card •R'tic H'weei is dedicated to Eric White: "In memory of Eric White, 1983 - 2011".<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited cards were printed in [[Virtual Block 8]] (2012) and [[Virtual Set 0]] (2014), so the credited cards span 2012–2014. The full list of people credited on Virtual cards is at [[Card Credits#Eric White|Card Credits]].
